text: And then comes the shortest verse in the whole Bible, and one of the most staggering.
The one man there who knew — knew — that in a few minutes Lazarus would be breathing again, stood at the grave of his friend and cried.
Not because he had run out of options.
He cried because the people he loved were broken, and death is a horror, and he would not stand there pretending it wasn't.
He did not skip the grief.
He walked all the way into it with them.
